fallbacks.cat_profile: global profile used for 10 of 10 categories
fallbacks.distance_decay_boundary: fit_decay hit its grid bound 3.0: treat as a lower bound
fallbacks.dropped_tables: place_time_users, stop_transitions_r6, trav_users_r8, trav_users_r9 are no longer released (pure noise on real data); no parameter reads them, so nothing further falls back
fallbacks.groups: no co-visit table released; defaults used
fallbacks.pool_size: Zipf fitted on tier place_users_r7; pool size not identifiable at that resolution
fallbacks.start_time_fine: time of day is released at coarse am/pm only; the 4-bin values are an assumed uniform-over-hours split of each coarse bin (not measured)
fallbacks.users_per_place_hist: res-8 tier: 7 keys above the noise floor, floor at 66 users (> 5.0); only the tail is observed (places.users_per_place_tail)
fallbacks.zipf_s_tier: zipf_s from coarse tier place_users_r7 (cells, not places)
